handback.title: Stories sharing a code file take turns to build
handback.summary: A story's build waits while another story sharing a code file is building, until that one merges.
handback.user_story: Two stories never build the same code file at once, while planning and review go on freely.

acceptance_criteria.text: A story's build waits until another open story sharing a code file has its pull request merged.
acceptance_criteria.words: A story's turn ends when its PR merges.

edge_cases.case: The owner says work while the other story is building: nothing builds and the reason names it.
The other story's worker is still running, with no pull request yet: this story waits.
A story sharing the file whose build never started holds no turn.
An issue with no parent builds as before.
GitHub fails to list the parent's stories: nothing builds and the card says why.

acceptance_criteria.text: Planning and plan review of a story never wait on another story's files.
acceptance_criteria.words: Planning and plan review never wait; only the worker's build does.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The planner and plan reviewer start as today; the test holds them beside a real clash.

acceptance_criteria.text: A markdown file shared by two stories never makes either build wait.
acceptance_criteria.words: Markdown files never group criteria and never make a story wait.

edge_cases.case: The same two stories also sharing a code file do wait.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each story merges to main on its own pull request, with no parent branch.
acceptance_criteria.words: Stories merge to main one by one. No parent branch.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Already true for every issue; an existing test pins it.

acceptance_criteria.text: A story whose own plan adds files beyond its assigned ones is checked again for clashes before it builds.
acceptance_criteria.words: Also: a story whose plan changes files beyond the ones it was assigned is checked again for clashes before it builds.

edge_cases.case: A plan keeping to its assigned files builds.

test_changes.tests/test_worker_pr.py::test_a_worker_w: Also pins 668.4: every story opens its own pull request into main.

answers.why: The 668.1 test now holds a story whose worker is still running, and the other story must wait.
